Purna Swaraj declaration, Congress session December 1929
Congress session December 1920 (where Non-cooperation was adopted)
Violent incident, 5 Feb 1922 (led to calling off Non-cooperation)

map_attempt_rules: Attach the supplied map firmly to the answer-book.
Use the exact symbol mentioned in the question (⊙, #, ⌒⌒⌒, 〰〰, ◊ etc.).
Write the NAME next to the symbol — half mark for name, half for location.
Visually-impaired candidates: attempt the written-alternative Q9(A)(i)-(v) and Q9(B)(i)-(v) instead — no map needed.
